blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States — A US jury convicted Huawei on Tuesday of stealing trade secrets and lying to regulators over its work with Iran, according to the Department of Justice, with the Chinese tech giant Huawei threatening to hit back with legal action. The world’s leading telecom equipment manufacturer, Huawei has been targeted by President Donald Trump’s administration, which alleges a risk of it spying on behalf of the Chinese government. The United States has previously urged countries not to use Huawei infrastructure for the rollout of new 5G mobile networks. The verdict followed a three-month trial at a New York […]...
